name: Arbor Park
summary: Arbor Park is a popular community shopping center located along San Antonio's bustling U.S. 281 corridor, serving the affluent northern suburbs with a convenient mix of retail, dining, and services. With a 4.3-star rating from nearly 1,500 reviews, this well-maintained center has established itself as a trusted neighborhood destination for residents of Stone Oak and surrounding communities.
demographics: Arbor Park serves the affluent northern San Antonio market along the U.S. 281 corridor, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The primary trade area includes Stone Oak, Encino Park, and surrounding master-planned communities with a demographic profile skewing toward families with children, professionals aged 30-55, and active retirees. Shoppers in this area demonstrate strong preferences for convenience-oriented retail, quality dining options, and service-based tenants, with frequent visits for everyday needs and family-oriented activities.
description: Arbor Park is a well-established community shopping center strategically located at 17700 U.S. 281 in the thriving northern corridor of San Antonio, Texas. Managed by Perform Properties, this open-air retail destination serves as a convenient hub for the surrounding Stone Oak and Encino Park communities, offering a carefully curated mix of retailers, restaurants, and service providers. With operating hours from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM daily, Arbor Park provides extended accessibility for busy families and professionals seeking quality shopping and dining experiences. The center has earned a strong reputation among local residents, reflected in its impressive 4.3-star rating from nearly 1,500 Google reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction and community engagement. Its prime location along one of San Antonio's most heavily trafficked corridors ensures excellent visibility and accessibility, making it a go-to destination for both everyday necessities and specialty retail needs in one of the city's most desirable residential areas.
